title: Salary Payment for Workers Engaged by Private Vendors in Government Contracts
what_it_is: Salary Payment for Workers Engaged by Private Vendors in Government Contracts

sections.label: Contractor performance, liquidation, worker salary claims
sections.summary: Government agencies monitor contractor performance, may adjust payment milestones or delivery schedule, and on liquidation workers' unpaid salaries get priority and can be claimed from the liquidator.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: During the contract, Government agencies will monitor the contractor's performance.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: If the contractor faces cash flow difficulties, the Government agency can consider adjusting the payment milestones or delivery schedule.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: In the unfortunate event of a contractor going into liquidation, the Government, like any service buyer, will rely on the provisions of the law to provide remedy for the affected workers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: As the Minister for Manpower has previously shared with this House, when a contractor goes into liquidation, the Companies Act provides for the apportionment of the unpaid salaries for workers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Unpaid salaries of workers will be accorded higher priority over claims by other unsecured creditors.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Affected workers can lodge salary claims with the appointed liquidator, who is required to give such claims priority.

sections.label: Company creditors and employee escrow account
sections.summary: Companies have other creditors, making it difficult for the Government to set monies aside only for employees, though a company can do so via a stipulated escrow account.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: Each company will have other creditors as well.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, it is very difficult to say that I put this aside only for the employees and it is difficult for the Government to do that.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: If the company itself sets aside monies in a certain escrow account and specifically stipulates that this is for employees, then that is something that the company can do.
